name: dsh-session-migrator
description: Move old sessions or whole workspaces out of DSH and restore them with their workspace registration: workspace/month grouped lists, Git branch and parent display, notes/todo protection, whole-workspace migration, workspace recreation on restore, configurable archive directory, multi-select restore, and DSH archive-state preservation. | 把旧会话或整个工作区迁移出 DSH，并在恢复时连带重建工作区登记：按工作区/月份分组的列表、Git 分支与父会话显示、备注/待办保护、整区迁移、恢复时重建工作区、可配置迁移目录、多选恢复、保留 DSH 归档状态。
